item.title: Old Cheverolette Set — Fri Aug 14, 7:00 PM — Pisgah Brewing Company Black Mountain
item.description:
This ain’t no Jet-Set band! Laura Blackley and David Zoll perform old-school country songs and duets (and play guitars) a la George and Tammy, Gram and Emmylou, and Loretta and Conway. Tom Pittman (host of WNCW’s Country Gold) plays pedal steel and the band is rounded out by a solid rhythm section with bass and drums. Vocal harmonies swimming in pedal steel that you can dance to. Wherever this band plays, it is always a good time. George and Tammy would be proud.
Founded in 2005, Pisgah is known for producing some of the most sought after craft ales in Western North Carolina. Pisgah Brewing Company currently operates the new indoor taproom with live music several days a week, plus our outdoor music venue in the summer and fall months with live music frequently on WNC’s premier outdoor music venue, the Pisgah Brewing Outdoor Stage. Be sure to come thirsty and ready rock! Check out our upcoming schedule at pisgahbrewing.com/events
Source: LiveMusicAsheville.com, Where Y'at AVL Music

item.title: Ledford Branch Loop: 5 mi., 500 ft. Elev. Gain — Fri Aug 21, 9:00 AM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group **[RSVP opens Sunday Aug. 16th, 8:00 pm]**
This is a typical lovely hike in the Bent Creek area. The route I've cobbled together adds up to about 5 miles and a relatively mild 500' elevation gain. With the hills and moderate pace -- around 2.5 mph -- I'd rate it 2.5 on a 0-10 difficulty scale. It's not a "fitness hike," but you'll need to be able to walk up and down some hilly terrain.
We'll traverse a mishmash of trail segments and connectors, from wide gravel roads to single-file trails, mostly good footing. Around halfway through we'll find a spot for a short snack break.
Wear sensible hiking footwear. Bring some water. If you're on the fence about hiking poles, you probably don't need them for this one.
***Dog Policy:*** Dogs are extremely welcome but must be leashed.

item.title: Botanical Painting for Beginners (4-sessions) — Tue Sep 1, 10:00 AM
item.description:
Botanical Painting for Beginners (4-sessions) with Camille Daunno Four Sessions Tuesdays, September 1, 8, 15, 22 | 10 am – 1 pm Register Here!
In this beginner level class, learn several watercolor painting techniques while experimenting with different brushes, techniques and other ways to enhance your personal style. All materials and supplies will be provided for this class and students will take home their in-progress or finished artwork. Camille Daunno is a retired Art Teacher with an undergraduate degree in Fine Art with graduate work in Textile Design. She worked in NYC as a designer for 10 years designing Fabric and wallpaper. Camille studied Art in NJ, NYC and Italy and studied Botanical Illustration and Painting at the NY Botanical Gardens with a certified instructor. She enjoys sharing her love of Botanical Art with her children and grandchildren. ● Members: Remember to enter your promo code upon checkout to receive your 10% member discount! Email adulteducation@nca

item.title: Come sing with us! Vocal workshop and rehearsal - Land Of The Sky Chorus — Tue Sep 22, 6:30 PM
item.description:
Asheville Area A Cappella Singers Whether you are an experienced singer, or just like to sing in your car, come join us as our guest! The Land of The Sky Chorus, located in Asheville, NC, is welcoming guests - men and women - who are interested in joining us in the world-wide community of a cappella singing.
No experience is required; we provide music, voice training and an enjoyable singing experience under expert leadership. Our repertoire of music is fun and spans many styles - most songs are easy to learn and sing. Learning materials are provided to help you get started, and you will be paired with a singing "Buddy" so you can join in right away.
We will be here to greet you as early as 6:15pm to help you get situated.
Source: Asheville Area A Cappella Singers
